description: A stocky, red-skinned humanoid charges straight toward the viewer, shown full figure from the party's eye level. It wears a white metal helmet with two short horns, a grey tunic crossed by brown leather straps and a belt with a round buckle, and brown boots. Its face is fierce, with heavy brows, small yellow eyes and tusked jaws. Its right hand swings a spiked ball mace held up on the left of the picture, and its left arm raises a tall wooden plank shield on the right. It pounds across a patch of green grass speckled with flowers, under a plain light blue sky. The colors are bright and the mood is aggressive and loud. Frame 1: the brute strides with its mouth shut, one boot forward. Frame 2: the body bobs and the other leg steps forward while its jaws gape in a roar. Both frames are short and equal, so the loop reads as a fast, stomping run toward the party with a repeated snarl.
title: Horned-helmet brute charging forward
